qualifier: epidermal keratinocyte, MITF-driven melanocyte and intestinal epithelium
name: Epidermal, melanocyte and intestinal epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, MITF-M melanocyte/melanosome pigmentation programmes and HNF4/CDX intestinal epithelial identity, which the tooth/ectodermal, pancreatic and sensory-organ confusables lack.

core: Regulation of vascular tone and blood pressure
qualifier: endothelial nitric oxide-cGMP signaling
name: eNOS-nitric oxide-cGMP regulation of vascular tone
rationale: All members concern vascular smooth muscle tone and arterial pressure, and the eNOS activation/trafficking, BH4 and NO-cGMP members distinguish it from the renin-angiotensin and smooth-muscle-contraction confusables.

qualifier: strand invasion, break-induced replication and intermediate resolution
name: Homologous recombination repair and recombination intermediate resolution
rationale: Members share homologous recombination-based repair (strand invasion, SDSA, BIR, sister chromatid exchange, intermediate resolution) with checkpoint context, unlike the NHEJ, replication-initiation and telomere confusables.

qualifier: nucleoside-analogue drug handling
name: Nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport, nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and ADME of nucleoside-analogue drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine/TPMT), whereas confusables cover de novo and salvage nucleotide synthesis or pyrimidine catabolism.

qualifier: HCN pacemaker and calcium-activated K+ channels
name: Action potential firing and SA node pacemaker currents
rationale: Members regulate action potential generation and propagation including SA node pacemaking via HCN and Ca2+-activated K+ channels, while confusables centre on resting membrane potential and K2P/KATP channels.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase and coenzyme A synthesis
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase and coenzyme A synthesis for acetyl-CoA
rationale: All members concern acetyl-CoA formation via PDH-catalysed pyruvate decarboxylation or pantothenate-to-CoA synthesis, unlike the other 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase, TCA/shuttle and NAD confusables.

qualifier: forebrain neuroblast division and stem cell maintenance
name: Forebrain neural progenitor division and self-renewal
rationale: Members concern division, asymmetric division and maintenance of forebrain neuroblasts and neural stem cells, distinct from confusables on forebrain patterning, glial fate, neuron migration and spindle orientation.

qualifier: diphthamide, selenocysteine, hydroxylation and recoding
name: Special amino acid residue modification and translational recoding
rationale: Members form unusual protein residues (diphthamide, selenocysteine, hydroxylysine/proline, formylglycine in arylsulfatases, oxidation) or recode stop codons, unlike confusables centred on hypusine, tRNA modification or collagen crosslinking/methylation.

qualifier: ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis and turnover
name: Sphingolipid, ceramide and sphingomyelin metabolism
rationale: All members concern sphingolipid/ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis, catabolism or homeostasis (membrane lipid and amide terms included), while every confusable is glycerophospholipid synthesis or remodelling.

qualifier: nephric duct and nephron formation via mesenchymal-epithelial transition
name: Nephric duct and nephron formation from metanephric mesenchyme
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric mesenchyme-to-nephron morphogenesis, distinct from confusables on tubule segment development, ureter and kidney growth regulation.

qualifier: ganglioside and hexosaminidase-dependent degradation
name: Lysosomal ganglioside and glycosphingolipid catabolism
rationale: Members concern lysosomal breakdown of gangliosides/glycosphingolipids including HEXA/HEXB defects, whereas confusables cover glycosaminoglycan, oligosaccharide and sialic acid/mannose metabolism.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and glucocorticoid axes
name: Hypothalamic-pituitary control of growth, appetite and stress
rationale: Members cover GH/prolactin/leptin signalling, feeding behaviour and HPA-axis glucocorticoid stress responses, distinguishing it from the GPCR gut-hormone, cAMP and neuropeptide-behaviour confusables.

qualifier: exocyst tethering and RHOQ
name: Exocyst-mediated vesicle tethering in GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members concern exocyst/RHOQ-driven tethering and targeting of Golgi-derived vesicles to the plasma membrane for GLUT4 delivery, while confusables concern insulin signalling and glucose import itself.

The three members (mitochondrial depolarization, osmotic-stress anti-apoptosis, negative regulation of nucleotide biosynthesis) share no single specific biological process that could be named without overreaching.

qualifier: retinol uptake, transport and retinal formation
name: Retinol uptake, transport and retinal metabolism
rationale: Members concern vitamin A/retinol and retinal metabolism and STRA6-mediated transport, distinct from the retinoic acid synthesis/signalling and visual-cycle confusables.

qualifier: chondroitin/dermatan sulfate and linkage region
name: Chondroitin and dermatan sulfate chain and linkage-region biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern CS/DS proteoglycan synthesis including the shared tetrasaccharide linkage region and its disease defects, unlike the heparan sulfate, keratan sulfate and O-glycosylation confusables.

qualifier: adaptor-coated vesicle cargo loading
name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis via coated vesicle cargo loading
rationale: Members concern assembly of melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles through coat/adaptor cargo loading, unlike confusables on general Golgi-lysosome trafficking, clathrin endocytosis or melanin synthesis.

qualifier: regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and antifungal response
name: Regulation of antimicrobial peptide and antifungal humoral defense
rationale: Members regulate antimicrobial peptide production, antibacterial/antifungal humoral responses and neutrophil cytotoxicity, while confusables centre on defensins, mucosal bacterial attachment and metal sequestration.

qualifier: lipoxygenase/epoxygenase products and pro-resolving mediators
name: Lipoxygenase and epoxygenase oxylipin and pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, lipoxin, HETE, hepoxilin and EET production and resolvin/protectin/maresin biosynthesis, distinct from confusables on omega-hydroxylation, fatty acid transport and eicosanoid receptors.

qualifier: orexin and neuropeptide GPCR signalling
name: Orexin-neuropeptide regulation of sleep-wake states
rationale: Members regulate REM/non-REM sleep and wakefulness through orexin/NPFF/QRFP neuropeptide G-protein signalling, while confusables concern feeding, social/mating behaviour or opioid synaptic signalling.

qualifier: HIV Nef downregulation of surface receptors
name: HIV Nef downregulation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I
rationale: All four members are Nef-mediated removal of immune surface proteins, distinct from HIV replication, host antiviral and MHC-I antigen-presentation confusables.

qualifier: beta-cell insulin secretion and insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion and insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
rationale: Members cover insulin processing and incretin/KATP/FFAR1-regulated secretion plus insulin receptor signalling and GLUT4 glucose import, unlike confusables on glucagon/gluconeogenesis, fatty acid oxidation or PGC-1alpha.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans, glycosphingolipids and oligosaccharides
name: Lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans, glycolipids and oligosaccharides
rationale: Members are lysosomal catabolism of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), gangliosides, oligosaccharides and sialic acid/amino sugars, while confusables are glycan and proteoglycan biosynthesis and glycosylation disorders.

qualifier: RB1-E2F/CDK G1/S control and ubiquitin-mediated regulator turnover
name: G1/S control via RB1-CDK and cell-cycle regulator degradation
rationale: Members cover RB1/E2F and CDK4/6-cyclin E G1/S control and ubiquitin-dependent turnover of p53, p27/p21, Cdc25A and cyclin D, unlike confusables on G2/M checkpoints, APC/C mitotic exit and replication origin licensing.

qualifier: microglial activation and amyloid-beta handling
name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance in Alzheimer pathology
rationale: Members concern microglial/astrocyte activation, amyloid-beta formation and clearance and tau tangle regulation, combining glial activation (absent from amyloid-fibril confusables) with amyloid handling (absent from microglial proliferation/migration confusables).
